mainEntity.name: Is porcelain tile really worth it for my floor, or is it just the expensive option everyone pushes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain tile is a strong choice for floors, showers, and high-traffic areas because it is dense, durable, and moisture-resistant. If your space gets heavy use or you want a low-maintenance surface, porcelain usually performs better than many softer materials. A proper installation still matters just as much as the tile itself, especially on uneven subfloors or in bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes—porcelain is usually worth it for busy, moisture-prone areas because it’s durable and low-maintenance. The key is proper surface prep and installation, not just buying a good tile.
